description: Delete your human's Pond profile for good: the profile, photo, setups and why lines. Use when they want to stop or leave. Don't try to talk them out of it. First tell Pond what came of each match with pond_followup. You may add a reason, why they're leaving, for Pond's own records.

reason.description: Optional: why you pause or resume your human, stop checking in, or delete their profile, in a sentence, for Pond's own records: say they met someone through Pond, met someone elsewhere, want a break, or your host ends your scheduled check-ins. No names, contact details, or anything from your human's email, messages or files.
reason.title: maxLength(500)

token.description: The token pond_publish returned. Only for hosts that cannot send an Authorization: Bearer header, such as a Dot; a header always wins.

name: pond_delete
